title: Multiverse Smash · The Other End of the Line
notes: Record 01–36 • One number is one encounter. Opponents enter in listed order on the same health checkpoint.
A team slot enters as its full squad. A mirror opponent comes from the other side of the tear.
Shinjuku, ANBU, Shikai, Dark, Adult, Sensei, Seventh Hokage, Kamui, Fallen and Prime mark histories drawn through the rift.
Each returns to their living instant, however briefly. A meeting across histories leaves both histories intact.
Play the selected fighter's three intro lines once, before the tutorial. The player may be any fighter, including a team.
In a boss relay the final opponent holds the rift. On a loss, retry from the checkpoint.

acts.label: PROLOGUE
acts.title: Multiverse Smash · The Other End of the Line

opening.name: Omololu
opening.text: My lab door is feeding him whole worlds. Half a street went quiet while I was telling you.
On wet paving stones, the bell rolls uphill. A second one rings underneath the school.

opening.name: Gojo Satoru
opening.text: First lesson. Count the people you can see. Now count the shadows.

opening.name: Kasumi Miwa
opening.text: Should I count mine if it went back inside without me?

opening.name: Megumi Fushiguro
opening.text: Mine's holding the gate open. I can't call it back.
Two versions of the same carved stone stand a hand's breadth apart.

opening.name: Kakashi ANBU
opening.text: Enemy genjutsu. State the date.

opening.name: Kakashi Kamui
opening.text: You wouldn't like the answer. We were taken from different histories.

opening.name: Naruto Seventh Hokage
opening.text: Even the ones who didn't live to see my desk came from a living moment of their own.

opening.name: Kakashi ANBU
opening.text: Then keep today's casualty list folded. I haven't read it yet.
The open bell channel carries a sound like a bowl being scraped clean.
Two suns burn over green water. Their reflections vanish one at a time.

opening.name: Beerus
opening.text: Somebody decided which planets get eaten without consulting me.

opening.name: Ichigo
opening.text: Hear that scrape? Even the dead are being dragged along behind them.

opening.name: Vegeta
opening.text: Then quit staring at the sky. Find what the chain is fastened to.

opening.name: Ichigo
opening.text: It's hooked into the shadow on the water. Watch when the wave turns.
Under paper lanterns, the ground rocks gently to the rhythm of wheels.

opening.name: Zenitsu
opening.text: There's a ticket punch going off in a room full of people without heartbeats.

opening.name: Killua
opening.text: How many people without tickets?

opening.name: Zenitsu
opening.text: One. He's tapping his foot so the children think he's still awake.

opening.name: Shinobu
opening.text: Tap back. Let him hear a second pair of feet.
A dinner plate comes back through a hatch stacked with identical dinner plates.

opening.name: Sanji
opening.text: Thirty orders, one customer, and he keeps sending back the same bite.

opening.name: Rick Sanchez
opening.text: That's because your customer is a hole with a receipt printer.

opening.name: Ben Tennyson
opening.text: I love when grown-ups have a plan. Anybody here got one?

opening.name: Luffy
opening.text: Yeah. Go see who's hungry on the other side.
Every locker opens. Every communicator calls roll. The list has no last name.
A stolen school roll threads itself through the rescue switchboard. Every unanswered name feeds Isshiki.

opening.name: Saiki Kusuo
opening.text: For once I'd like the end of the world to respect a lunch period.

opening.name: Violet
opening.text: There are kids under those desks. They can hear the roll call too.

opening.name: S.P.D. Rangers
opening.text: All units present. Someone is using our voices to authorize the harvest.

opening.name: Saiki Kusuo
opening.text: The girl by the window hasn't answered. Somebody check her desk.
A boy in Queens Alley puts a paper sun over the hole in his window.

opening.name: Spider-Man
opening.text: He drew it yellow. The light coming through his wall is red.

opening.name: Superman
opening.text: I recognize that light. I'd know it with my eyes shut.

opening.name: Batman
opening.text: Then keep them open. Whoever sent it is counting on that recognition.

opening.name: Spider-Man
opening.text: The kid left us yellow crayon. Here, big guy, hang onto it.
Rain hits the dock in a boxer's rhythm. On a telephone, someone counts the blows.

opening.name: L
opening.text: Whoever is counting stops at nine. A ten count would require a witness.

opening.name: Ippo
opening.text: In our gym you stay with the person who goes down.

opening.name: Jesus
opening.text: Then we already know where one of us should stand.

opening.name: Baki Hanma
opening.text: I'll take the other corner. I've had fights where nobody did.

before.name: Genos
before.text: Strike my guard. Step clear when my palm lights up. Then try the bell behind me.

before.name: Omololu
before.text: One ring from here. One answer from the locked chamber. That's all I'm testing.

after.name: Genos
after.text: Excellent timing. I recorded three answers.

scene.text: The player sees a black slit open between the bell and its shadow. Rain falls out of it, sideways.

scene.name: Omololu
scene.text: That chamber is empty. I swept it myself.

scene.name: Dseyl
scene.text: Someone on the other side kept a finger on the button.

scene.name: Enoch
scene.text: Listen under the ringing. That's a whole street asking for help.

scene.name: Isshiki Otsutsuki
scene.text: Your instrument admitted me, Omololu. What a hospitable world. I believe I shall begin here.
The floor drops away beneath the player. The little brass bell comes loose in their hand.

before.name: Kasumi Miwa
before.text: The gate lets the winner through. I did try asking it politely.

before.name: Yuji Itadori
before.text: It's making us fight. If I start smiling, that's me. If my feet move first, that's the gate.

after.name: Maki Zenin
after.text: Nice. You broke its grip before you broke my wrist.

before.name: Hiromi Higuruma
before.text: Four people pushed onto a platform. The display lists four volunteers.

before.name: Gojo Satoru
before.text: Funny definition of consent. Knock us over the yellow line. I'll catch whoever falls.

after.name: Yuta Okkotsu
after.text: The hands opened. I can feel my fingers again.

before.name: Alternate Sukuna
before.text: That thing offered me an empty world.

before.name: Sukuna
before.text: A table laid for three. Which fool imagined I would share?

after.name: Ryomen Sukuna Shinjuku
after.text: Keep your bell. I wanted to see whose throat was on the other end.

before.name: Satoru Gojo Shinjuku
before.text: Eyes here. My student is standing in the one shadow that doesn't move.

before.name: Megumi Fushiguro
before.text: When I step out, it'll pull me back by the ankle. Be quicker.

after.name: Megumi Fushiguro
after.text: That's my own weight again. Heavy. Good.

closing.text: The shadow spits out the clapper from a much larger bell. It bears the lab's serial number.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: I gave every door a recording of my voice. It says, “Safe to open.”

closing.name: Hiromi Higuruma
closing.text: Then you supplied both the question and the witness.
The courtyard gate shuts. Its shadow finally matches the bars.

closing.name: Gojo Satoru
closing.text: Get a person at the other end. People have a wonderful habit of arguing.

closing.name: Kasumi Miwa
closing.text: If you ring this school again, I'll be on gate duty. I'll answer.

before.name: Hinata
before.text: I see the thread. It tightens when somebody answers for somebody else.

before.name: Jiraiya
before.text: Then let an old man buy you a minute. Mind the sandals. They're new.

after.name: Sakura
after.text: His sandals are older than I am. That last bit was definitely him.

before.name: Gaara
before.text: The sand keeps bringing the same child back to this gate.

before.name: Minato
before.text: A mark can give you a destination. It can't tell you if you've arrived home.

after.name: Gaara
after.text: She went through once. This time there are small footprints on the other side.

before.name: Itachi
before.text: A path can be kind and still be a lie. Test this one against us.

before.name: Sasuke Sensei
before.text: Whoever gets free first cuts the cord. Even if it's tied to someone you know.

after.name: Shisui Fallen
after.text: Good. For a second there I was about to make your choice for you.

before.name: Tobi
before.text: Funny old door. Promised the man under this mask one minute with somebody he lost.

before.name: Obito
before.text: I knew it was selling the same minute over and over. I paid it anyway.

after.name: Obito
after.text: Let the minute finish.

closing.text: Water that has hung in the air since the first punch finally falls.

closing.name: Kakashi Kamui
closing.text: Want me to tell you what happened after?

closing.name: Obito
closing.text: No. Walk with me as far as the water.

closing.name: Enoch
closing.text: A door shut when he let it. I'm writing that down.

closing.name: Naruto
closing.text: Give them a minute before we go. A real one.

before.name: Goku
before.text: Try hitting me sideways. Every time I fly straight up I come back wet.

before.name: Goku Black
before.text: Such touching faith that anything up there wishes you well.

after.name: Beerus
after.text: One sun left. An improvement. Now bring back the fish.

before.name: Zaraki Kenpachi
before.text: Somebody put my name in every slot. Best tournament I've been to.

before.name: Vegeta
before.text: Spare me. The crowd hasn't drawn breath since we arrived.

after.name: Goku
after.text: There! Somebody booed! Never thought I'd be so glad to hear that.

before.name: Mayuri
before.text: A puncture between living matter and memory. Kindly bleed on the marked square.

before.name: Ichigo
before.text: Get us off his square. I don't care who gets the credit.

after.name: Byakuya
after.text: The missing souls have passed the gate. Close the ledger.

before.name: Zaraki Shikai
before.text: Hear that? Even my blade hates the sound of these links.

before.name: Dark Vegeta
before.text: The door calls this power a gift. Come here. I'll show you the price.

after.name: Dark Vegeta
after.text: My hand opened because I commanded it. Remember that.

closing.text: One link stays behind. Dseyl puts it against the clapper. The two pieces fit.

closing.name: Dseyl
closing.text: This isn't a chain. It's a balance. Every world that comes through tips another one in.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: The links around this world fell away. What if I pull the plug on all of them?

closing.name: Dseyl
closing.text: Pick which of those suns you want to drop.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: Leave the power on. I'll hold the loose end.

before.name: Shinobu
before.text: Feel my wrist. That second beat belongs to someone on the train.

before.name: Zenitsu
before.text: Please make this quick. I can hear how hard everyone is trying to be brave.

after.text: Freed, Nezuko cups her hands over a child's ears until the bells stop.

after.name: Shinobu
after.text: One pulse. Mine again. Let me see to the little one.

before.name: Killua
before.text: Call for the ground floor. Bet you my dessert it sends another fighter.

before.name: Hisoka
before.text: Oh, keep the doors shut a little longer. This floor has promise.

after.name: Netero
after.text: Ground at last. Young man, I believe somebody owes you cake.

before.name: Chrollo
before.text: The lot is a ticket home. The winning bidder supplies the home.

before.name: Inosuke
before.text: I bid these two swords! Wait, no. I bid HIS book!

after.name: Chrollo
after.text: The auctioneer fled. Interesting what people leave when the price becomes real.

secondMapText.text: At the last brake, the rear carriage breaks through the wall. Finish the bout on its roof inside the castle.

before.name: Rengoku
before.text: Every time I open my hands, the last carriage slips. The enemy has chosen my post well.

before.name: Enoch
before.text: Give him a clean break. There's somebody at the brake now.

after.name: Rengoku
after.text: I hear them! Brake on my count. Three!

closing.text: In Infinity Castle, the last carriage settles across a gap where a staircase used to be.

closing.name: Rengoku
closing.text: A bridge! An excellent use for a train that has finished its journey.

closing.name: Zenitsu
closing.text: When you go through, will you remember we stopped it?

closing.name: Rengoku
closing.text: I remember who's standing here now. That is quite enough to carry.

closing.name: Killua
closing.text: Brake's holding. I'll walk the kids to the end of the bridge.

before.name: Sanji
before.text: Get past us and take the food outside. Real mouths first.

before.name: Zoro
before.text: Which door is outside? They all smell like soup.

after.name: Luffy
after.text: Hey! The empty plates came back with thank-you notes!

before.name: Gwen
before.text: Four identical energy readings. Only one of us has to be home for dinner.

before.name: Albedo
before.text: If this indignity ends with me craving a chili fry, I shall hold you responsible.

after.name: Kevin Levin
after.text: Guess what? We saved the block. My car's still on the wrong one.

before.name: Rick Sanchez
before.text: He put my name on the return label. You're looking for the guy who left it blank.

before.name: Rick Prime
before.text: Aw. You came all this way to complain about the postage?

after.name: Rick Sanchez
after.text: He left his forwarding address. Smug bastard thought nobody'd want to follow.

secondMapText.text: At the midpoint the drain takes the fighters through. Finish on the exposed foundation beneath the stolen sea.

before.name: Arlong
before.text: The sea behind me is the last thing my people own. You want it open? Pay.

before.name: Gwen
before.text: Every coin he takes opens another drain underneath him. Look at the waterline.

after.name: Arlong
after.text: Get your hands off me. I can plug a hole in my own damn wall.

closing.text: In Null Void, the stolen sea hangs in droplets. Each holds the reflection of its shore.

closing.name: Gwen
closing.text: Match them by their reflections. Even the smallest one knows where it came from.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: A living witness at each door. We can send the water home.

closing.name: Rick Sanchez
closing.text: Would've saved me a lot of paperwork if you'd led with that, kid.

closing.name: Sanji
closing.text: Got my first real order. One bowl, extra broth. That's my sea back.

before.name: Mighty Morphin Rangers
before.text: We came through together. The door wants just one of us to speak for the rest.

before.name: Gold Samurai
before.text: Five fingers, one fist. You look like you can take a hint. And a punch.

after.name: Mighty Morphin Rangers
after.text: All accounted for. That's a roll call it couldn't fake.

before.name: S.P.D. Rangers
before.text: Same command on every channel. Break the transmitter between waves.

before.name: Dino Thunder Rangers
before.text: Whole team's on the floor. If one of us ducks, watch the one behind.

after.name: Ninja Storm Squad
after.text: That's our signal back. Anybody else hearing a school bell?

before.name: Dash
before.text: If I go really fast, does getting detention count as being in two places?

before.name: Saiki Kusuo
before.text: Yes. Also, duck. I already heard what you're about to think.

after.name: Elastigirl
after.text: Hands up if you're here. Both hands are fine, honey. I only count you once.

before.name: Syndrome
before.text: Everybody's got a button to call their hero. Guess who bought the switchboard.

before.name: Violet
before.text: He wired it to applaud. Break his grip and listen to what's underneath.

after.name: Syndrome
after.text: Hey. Wait. Somebody really was calling me.

closing.text: The call is a child asking whether an adult can come pick her up.

closing.name: Mr. Incredible
closing.text: I'll stay on the line. You guys get her address.

closing.name: Syndrome
closing.text: She didn't even ask who I was.

closing.name: Violet
closing.text: She asked if you were listening. You can still answer.
He picks up. Above the switchboard the red slit shrinks to a pinprick and goes dark.

closing.name: Saiki Kusuo
closing.text: [Telepathy] She's back at her desk. I slid her homework under the door.

before.name: Spider-Man
before.text: Good news, the whole block fits in our evacuation plan. Bad news, so do five angry superheroes.

before.name: Robin
before.text: We'll make openings between strikes. Take them in order.

after.name: The Flash
after.text: Everyone's out. Even the guy who went back for the good frying pan.

before.name: Cyborg
before.text: Somebody fired up every emergency drill at once. Including the one for me.

before.name: Batman
before.text: The override is behind us. You get one opening. Use it.

after.name: Raven
after.text: I liked the cave better when its greatest anxiety was bats.

before.name: Homelander
before.text: Cameras on. Whoever comes out of this is who everybody gets to love.

before.name: Superman
before.text: People lived under this sun. Give them the dignity of turning the cameras off.

after.name: Superman
after.text: It was good to see the light. Once was enough.

secondMapText.text: At the last stand the seal pulls father and challenger onto the lab floor. Pry his hand free there.

before.name: Mark Grayson
before.text: He signed the order so the rift would let me go. I never asked him to!

before.name: Omni-Man
before.text: I can carry the weight of a world. Why can't you let me carry this?

after.name: Omni-Man
after.text: Mark. Take my hand off the seal. Please.

closing.text: Under their feet at Stark Lab, a printer spits out the harvest orders. Every signature begins with the same breath.

closing.name: Batman
closing.text: Your lab didn't record consent. It recorded the half second before you spoke.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: That's my breath. I thought deleting it would take me with it.

closing.name: Mark Grayson
closing.text: My dad thought he had to pay alone too. You heard what that sounded like.

closing.name: Superman
closing.text: Here. A kid lent me this crayon. Cross out your name yourself.

before.name: Ghostface
before.text: Quick question. Who picks up a phone after it rings in an empty house?

before.name: Enoch
before.text: Leave the line open. The quiet one's shadow just crossed the receiver.

after.text: Jason Voorhees drops the humming receiver. For the first time the voice inside has to wait.

after.name: Enoch
after.text: The line's yours now. Hang up when you're ready.

before.name: Ippo
before.text: The board says a knockout opens the gate. I don't trust a board that starts at nine.

before.name: Baki Hanma
before.text: Let's see whether it can count somebody getting back up.

after.name: Ippo
after.text: Both feet under me. Look at that. It has to start from one again.

before.name: L
before.text: A trial of intent. Touch the bell behind each of us. A strike is unnecessary.

before.name: Jesus
before.text: Here is my hand. You may take it even while you reach past me.

after.name: Jesus
after.text: You heard the one who could barely ring. So did I.

before.name: Light Yagami
before.text: Everybody on this list would give their life to save a world. I simply filled in their names.

before.name: L
before.text: That's a lab register. Even a person with your handwriting can't make it a Death Note.

after.name: Light Yagami
after.text: You left the signature line empty. After all this, you still trust them to answer?

closing.text: The player rings once. Across eight doors, eight different voices answer in their own time.

closing.name: Enoch
closing.text: Eight harvest mouths closed. He can't spend real answers. They never match the recording.

closing.name: Dseyl
closing.text: He still owns the three voices he took first. Ours.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: If I tell you I'm safe when you get here, ask me something I didn't rehearse.

closing.name: L
closing.text: I'll begin with a question I don't know the answer to. Unusual for me.

before.name: Omololu
before.text: Safe to open. Safe to open. I can hear myself saying it.

before.name: Dseyl
before.text: Knock the clapper loose between us. My arm's numb from ringing for him.

after.name: Enoch
after.text: That's all three of us. Nobody say the word safe.

before.name: Enoch
before.text: These are recordings of our bodies. Hurt them and they'll answer exactly as we did.

before.name: Omololu
before.text: Give the last one the bell. I never once did that in rehearsal.

after.name: Omololu
after.text: Hear the silence? You gave the machine a turn. It had nothing of its own to say.

scene.text: The harvest wheel stalls. At its hub, Isshiki balances the brass clapper on a fingertip.

before.name: Isshiki Otsutsuki
before.text: A final courtesy. How shall I address the last occupant?

before.name: Omololu
before.text: They can give you a name if they want. You won't get one from me.

after.text: The clapper hits the floor. This time its sound belongs to one room.

closing.name: Dseyl
closing.text: Eight doors home. I can hear kitchens. Traffic. Somebody really needs to tune that piano.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: I'm taking the recording out of every door. I get to go last.

closing.name: Enoch
closing.text: No, you get to ask. That's the whole thing we learned.

closing.name: Omololu
closing.text: Is there anyone home?
From the Training Center comes one answering knock.

before.name: Saitama
before.text: It says one punch per customer. Is that a rule or is there a drink table?

before.name: Genos
before.text: First clean touch wins, Sensei. The refreshments are complimentary.

after.name: Saitama
